- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the corpus of card 174, When this card is merged, Then it also holds one fixture per shape with a header comment: a module with no endpoints, an empty record, a phrase or endpoint with the longest allowed name, and a failure raised only by native code and never declared
  2. Given each new fixture, When the iterating test runs, Then its hand-written expected outcome is checked (the exact diagnostic code and line, or the source-map records and passing specs), the test file is unchanged, and any fixture that exposes a real bug is reported with the bug filed as a card, not pinned as expected
  3. Given the gate and CI, When the card is merged, Then the whole corpus still runs in well under a minute and no existing test is removed or renamed
